Tasks start in the cloud for search, planning and reasoning, then hand sensitive steps down to the Mac without restarting or losing context. An on-device privacy gate decides what may cross: keep local, mask, refuse, or ask for consent. Perplexity also open-sourced the 0.6B classifier behind that gate, which records the highest character F1 (0.629) among twelve detectors evaluated. Hybrid compute is live now for Pro, Max and Enterprise on Apple silicon Macs with 24GB of unified memory.
